hero.headline: BATHYMETRIC SURVEYS
hero.title: BATHYMETRIC & HYDROGRAPHIC SURVEY SERVICES IN KENYA
hero.description:
Advanced Underwater Mapping for Dams, Rivers, Lakes & Coastal Engineering in Kenya and beyond.

We offer high-precision bathymetric and hydrographic surveys using sonar-based depth measurement systems integrated with GNSS RTK positioning to map underwater terrain for engineering, environmental, and infrastructure projects across Kenya and East Africa.

From dams to rivers and reservoirs — we map what lies beneath the surface.

whatIsBathymetricSurveys.headline: What is Bathymetric Surveys?
whatIsBathymetricSurveys.description: Bathymetric surveys involve measuring the depth of water bodies and charting the underwater terrain. This technique is crucial for understanding sediment levels, water volume, and underwater hazards. It supports safer construction, better water resource management, and proactive environmental protection. SmartGrid Surveying uses high-resolution echo sounders, GNSS positioning systems, and remote-controlled survey boats to access shallow and restricted water zones safely and efficiently.

bathymetricWorkflow.headline: OUR HYDROGRAPHIC SURVEY WORKFLOW
bathymetricWorkflow.description: Structured underwater survey pipeline for engineering-grade deliverables:

steps.label: 1. Project Planning & Waterbody Assessment
steps.description:
Site reconnaissance
Depth expectations & hazard mapping
Survey line planning

steps.label: 2. GNSS Control Setup
steps.description:
RTK GNSS positioning
Vertical datum alignment
Shoreline control points

steps.label: 3. Bathymetric Data Acquisition
steps.description:
Single-beam sonar scanning
Survey vessel transects
Continuous depth logging

steps.label: 4. Data Processing & Correction
steps.description:
Sound velocity corrections
Water level / tidal adjustments
Noise filtering

steps.label: 5. Surface Modelling
steps.description:
Bathymetric grids (DEM)
Depth contour generation
3D underwater surface modelling
